questions: Should the function handle CSV files with different delimiters (e.g., tab, semicolon) or only comma-separated values?
What encoding should be assumed when reading the CSV file? The reference solution uses UTF-8, but is this guaranteed?
How should empty values in the specified column be counted? Should they be counted as distinct occurrences of an empty string or ignored?
Should the function handle quoted values in the CSV (e.g., values containing commas or newlines)?
What should happen if the CSV file has a header row but no data rows? Should it return an empty dictionary or raise an exception?
Should the function handle duplicate column names in the CSV header? If so, which column's values are used?
What should happen if the download fails (e.g., network error, 404)? Should it raise the exception from urlretrieve or catch and re-raise?
Should the function handle CSV files with varying numbers of columns per row (malformed CSV)?
